يقتبس (form VIII)
# يَقْتَبِسُ (yaqtabisu) /jaq.ta.bi.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# يُقْتَبَسُ (yuqtabasu) /juq.ta.ba.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# يَقْتَبِسَ (yaqtabisa) /jaq.ta.bi.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# يُق
